name: Garlicky Shrimp Scampi with Bell Pepper & Spaghetti

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
510 g (1 quarter coin = 56 g) spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place in a large bowl, cover with cold water, and set aside to thaw. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry bell peppers and parsley.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 red bell peppers
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Seed and cut bell peppers into small strips. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry.
Add butter to skillet and let it melt. Add shrimp and cook, stirring frequently, until opaque and pink, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium and add more butter to skillet. Then add garlic, bell peppers, and crushed red pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until peppers are tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth to skillet and cook until it reduces, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 177 ml (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate ⅓ cup of Parmesan.
Add pasta, shrimp, parsley, and Parmesan to skillet. Pour in remaining broth and drizzle with lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper and toss until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
177 ml (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
juice of 1 ½ lemon
⅜ tsp salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Serve pasta on a plate or in a bowl and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
